$comment: THE CATALOGUE OF THINGS YOU CAN BUILD. Authored like the action catalogue:
curated, versioned, and never renamed once shipped. An item `id` is a shipped
ID under the CLAUDE.md rule — it appears inside spend events forever, so it may
be retired but never renamed and never reused for a different thing.
PRICE IS TUNABLE, ID AND SLOT ARE NOT. Prices may be retuned freely, because
the resolved cost is stored on the spend event at purchase time — exactly the
same reason ECONOMY §6 resolves stat affinity at log time. A 2031 rebalance
cannot make a 2026 purchase cost more, or less, than it did.
PRICING, per ECONOMY.md §3: the first item in a room costs about ONE GOOD
WEEK, not one good day. At ~130 Embers a day that is ~900. An upgrade you can
afford the day you unlock it teaches the player that the currency is
meaningless, and that lesson is not recoverable. tests.js enforces the floor,
because this is a rule that erodes one reasonable-looking discount at a time.
SKILL POINTS GATE, EMBERS PAY. `unlock_level` is read against the skill tree
level from Character.build() — permission, not payment (currencies.json,
skill:home). A locked item is always VISIBLE and never hidden: seeing what is
ahead is the reward, and a shop that hides things you have not earned reads as
a shop that thinks you are behind.
EVERY SKILL HAS SOMETHING TO BUY. ADR-020 applied to spending: a tree you can
fill but never spend from is a locked tree with extra steps. All five appear
here and all five have an entry item at unlock_level 1.
SLOTS, NOT FREE PLACEMENT. Each item sits in exactly one named slot and no two
items share one. Free placement is a Tier 2 question and changes nothing about
the ledger when it arrives — a position would be a field on the spend event,
which §2.6 already permits without a migration.
ART: the sprites are hand-authored inline SVG in room.html, so there is no
licence question and no binary in the shell. Kenney (CC0) remains the decided
answer when real art is wanted — NEXT.md, slice 1.2. The LimeZu pack in
C:\Projects\art-packs is non-commercial only and must not be used.
